canvas: 2560x1440 PNG (16:9) or larger, same aspect ratio. Layer files must use the same canvas size and alignment as the flattened file.
masterStylePrompt: Original cinematic retro 1980s/1990s political-thriller anime illustration; angular anatomy; strong ink contours; precise hard cel-shadow shapes; painterly location background; muted navy and charcoal base; rust-orange and amber rim light; subtle film texture; dramatic but restrained facial expression; clear visual hierarchy; 16:9 composition; generous crop room; no baked-in text, captions, numbers, channel logos, signatures or watermarks. Keep the same proportions, palette and line weight across shots. Illustrative editorial staging, not photographic evidence.

assets.prompt: A distant commercial cargo ship in a Gulf waterway at dusk, red navigation light in foreground, dark teal sea, rust-orange horizon, restrained tension, empty upper-left space for location label. Separate ship, foreground water and sky layers.
assets.composition: Red navigation light on a foreground channel-marker buoy, lower-left (about 24% from left, 64% down), with its red reflection streaking down the water below it. Cargo ship sits on the horizon mid-right (about 64% from left, 48% down). Horizon line about 52% down. Upper-left sky left empty.

layers.note: mid-distance water, transparent above the horizon
foreground water + buoy + red light, transparent elsewhere

assets.prompt: An austere diplomatic corridor and adjacent negotiation-table composition, warm amber desk light, closed blank folder, chairs unoccupied, no insignia, no writing. Separate lamp glow, folder and room layers. A symbolic scene.
assets.composition: Corridor receding on the left half; table on the right half with the closed folder at about 66% from left, 66% down; amber desk lamp at about 78% from left, 44% down.

assets.prompt: Recognizable editorial anime portrait of Benjamin Netanyahu, dark suit, tense but neutral expression, angular facial drawing, heavy ink contours, warm highlights; separate character and plain background; no speech bubble.

assets.prompt: Anonymous civilian inside an evacuation bus, blue-gray dawn, hand holding a small travel bag, bus window catching warm interior light, thoughtful restrained expression. Original illustrative person, no claim to depict a particular survivor.
assets.composition: Civilian seated left of centre, face about 40% from left and 34% down, looking right toward the window; hand gripping the travel bag strap lower-left (about 30% from left, 74% down); bus window fills the right half (centre about 68% from left, 38% down) showing an empty road at dawn.

layers.note: bus interior + window frame, transparent window glass

assets.prompt: Anonymous adults meeting at a civilian arrival point beside buses, quiet embrace, volunteers and tea table in soft background, muted winter palette with gentle amber light, dignified wide composition. Original illustrative people.
assets.composition: Embrace centred slightly left (about 44% from left, 55% down); buses right; volunteers and tea table soft in the background.

assets.prompt: Large peaceful student-and-worker demonstration on a broad Paris street, varied ordinary adults, some plain unlettered placards, open daylight, painterly architecture, respectful wide framing. Original illustration.
assets.composition: Street recedes to a vanishing point near the centre; crowd fills the lower half; plain placards held above heads around 45–60% down.

assets.prompt: A separate Paris street at dusk, distant police lights and thin atmospheric smoke, a few small anonymous silhouettes, no visible injury, no dramatic fire or invented specific confrontation. Designed for a short contextual cutaway.
assets.composition: Police lights small and distant near the centre-right; smoke drifting across the middle band.

assets.prompt: Long server corridor, cold blue light, repeated rack perspective, amber status lamps, empty screens with no numbers or logos, deep shadows, original painted anime environment.
assets.composition: One-point perspective; vanishing point at the centre.

assets.prompt: Fictional adult financial analyst in a dark office, tired concentrated face reflected in a blank monitor, red and amber screen glow, severe cel shading, separate face/monitor/background layers.
assets.composition: Blank monitor fills the centre-right; the analyst's reflected face sits in the monitor at about 60% from left, 40% down; the real analyst in left-foreground profile (about 22% from left). Monitor surface must stay blank so figures can be composited in code.

assets.prompt: US Capitol at dusk with accurate architectural reference, solemn wide composition, deep navy sky and warm windows, no crowd, no winner banners, no imaginary security incident.
assets.composition: Dome centred; sky in the upper third clear for a label.

assets.prompt: Neutral American polling-place interior, closed door or empty ballot box in foreground, warm hallway light, ordinary civic atmosphere, no party endorsement, no legible signage baked into image.
assets.composition: Closed door centred (about 50% from left, 45% down) so the final slow push lands on it; ballot box foreground left.

assets.prompt: Separate object cutouts: blank calendar page, unmarked travel bag, closed blank folder, student notebook, shopping receipt without numbers, blank voting slip. Consistent line weight and cel shading; transparent backgrounds.
assets.composition: Supply each object as its own transparent PNG (files below); the combined sheet is optional.
